summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are playing soccer when they meet the calico cat, Taii, who frequently comes to Café Poirot for food. They follow the cat into a refrigerated delivery truck where the kids stumble on to a body in a box. The drivers killed the man and are doing their route to establish an alibi as the cold will alter the time of death. Conan and the Detective Boys see a dead man in one of the Boxes of the refrigerated delivery truck and are stuck inside since the deliverymen closed the door.
